themes.switch: data-theme on <html>, kept in localStorage key 'theme'

bar.purpose: The header face; set apart by shadow-bar, never coloured.

paper.purpose: The face of every box: cards, panels, menus, dialogs, inputs.

sunk.purpose: Hover fills, the selected list item, pressed-in areas.

edge.purpose: The 4px pixel edge around every box.

line-strong.purpose: Input borders and edges that must be seen (3:1).

ink-soft.purpose: Secondary text that still reads as body.

action-hover.purpose: An action under the pointer, and its shaded bevel edge.

gold.purpose: Look here: wordmark block, Sign up, toast edges, selection, current stage.

gold-hi.purpose: The lit top edge of gold bevels.

gold-lo.purpose: The shaded bottom edge of gold bevels; a gold box edge via --box-edge.

gold-soft.purpose: Look-closer chips and notices, the preview banner.

alert-ink.purpose: Status: closed, unpaid, delete, form errors (text).

alert-soft.purpose: Status: closed, unpaid, delete, form errors (fill).

hero-sky.purpose: The landing hero's sky, matched to the top edge of its image. Both modes.
hero-sky.note: Token in styles.css and the DESIGN.md colour table; not in the DESIGN.md frontmatter.

wordmark.purpose: The product name in the header and footer (text-wordmark, 1.375rem bold).

display.purpose: The one big number or headline on a page (text-display, 3.25rem).

title.purpose: The name at the top of a card (text-title, 1.125rem, 600).

label.purpose: Pixelify Sans readouts only: IDs, dates, codes, timers, counts, small labels. The readout class adds uppercase. Never sentences, headings or button text.

hero.purpose: The landing hero's headline only: clamp(3.25rem, 9.2vw, 7rem), line-height 0.96, letter-spacing -0.035em. Token in styles.css (--text-hero); not in the DESIGN.md frontmatter.

shadows.name: shadow-pixel
shadows.value: 0 -4px 0 0 var(--box-edge, var(--color-edge)), 0 4px 0 0 var(--box-edge, var(--color-edge)), -4px 0 0 0 var(--box-edge, var(--color-edge)), 4px 0 0 0 var(--box-edge, var(--color-edge))
shadows.purpose: Pixel corners: four hard 4px edges that don't meet. Every box uses it. Recolour one box with --box-edge (e.g. var(--color-gold-lo)). Never nest a pixel box inside another.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Hover on a clickable box: the pixel edge darkens to line-strong.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.value: 0 -4px 0 0 var(--color-line-strong), 0 4px 0 0 var(--color-line-strong), -4px 0 0 0 var(--color-line-strong), 4px 0 0 0 var(--color-line-strong), 0 12px 0 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink) 18%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Menus and dialogs: the line-strong pixel edge plus a hard drop below.

shadows.name: shadow-bevel-action
shadows.value: inset 0 calc(-1 * var(--press, 4px)) 0 var(--color-action-hover), inset 0 4px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-action) 65%, var(--color-gold-hi))
shadows.purpose: Primary button: lit top, shaded bottom. Pair with press.

shadows.name: shadow-bevel-gold
shadows.value: inset 0 calc(-1 * var(--press, 4px)) 0 var(--color-gold-lo), inset 0 4px 0 var(--color-gold-hi)

shadows.name: shadow-bevel-paper
shadows.value: inset 0 calc(-1 * var(--press, 4px)) 0 var(--color-line-strong), inset 0 4px 0 var(--color-paper)

shadows.name: shadow-bevel-mark
shadows.purpose: The wordmark's small gold block and the theme switch knob.

motion.name: ease-step
motion.purpose: Everything moves in 3 visible steps; default timing for every transition class.

motion.name: duration-default
motion.purpose: Default transition duration, also the pop-in and toast-in keyframe length.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pressable blocks sink and lose that much of their bottom bevel.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

shape.radius: 0px everywhere, including avatars, dots and chips
shape.gridGap: at least 1rem between pixel boxes, because the edge sits 4px outside each box

narrative.northStar: Golden hour in a mountain town.
narrative.overview:
Approachable, cozy and a little game-like. Boxes are solid blocks with square, stepped "pixel" corners. Buttons are blocks with a lit top edge and a shaded bottom edge that sink when pressed. Things move in a few visible steps instead of gliding. The words stay plain and human; the game feel lives in shapes, colour and motion, never in game words.

Two modes, same roles. Dark mode (the landing page's valley greens) is the default; light mode is warm cream and terracotta. A visitor switches with the sun/moon switch in the header: a square track with a gold block that slides, in steps, to the current mode. The choice is kept in their browser.
keyCharacteristics: Every corner is square; no rounding anywhere.
Pixel corners (shadow-pixel) on every box; no box inside another.
Bevelled pressable blocks that sink 2px on hover and 4px when pressed.
Familjen Grotesk for reading; Pixelify Sans for readouts only.
Gold for look here; Adobe for actions; status colours carry meaning.
No blur, soft shadows, glows, gradients or blurred backdrops.

rules.name: The Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold means "look here or you're here": the next thing to do, the current step, something that needs a check, something done. Use it sparingly; never as a large background.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Adobe (`action`) is for buttons that do something. Links and accent text use `action-ink`.

rules.name: The Status Rule
rules.body: A chip or notice's colour is its meaning: `good` is in your favour, `gold` is look closer, `alert` is against you or destructive, neutral is `sunk`. Never pick a status colour for decoration.

rules.name: The Plain Header Rule
rules.body: The header has no colour. It is set apart from the page by its own face (`bar`) and a hard 4px edge underneath (`shadow-bar`).

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Sentences, headings and button text are never in the pixel face.

dos: **Do** use roles (`bg-paper`, `text-ink`...) instead of raw colours.
**Do** give every box pixel corners with `shadow-pixel`.
**Do** keep text at WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text) in both modes.
**Do** use the pixel face only for readouts.
**Do** check light and dark mode for every page you change.
donts: **Don't** round corners, blur shadows or use gradients.
**Don't** use Gold for large areas or for decoration.
**Don't** use a thick coloured line down one side of a box.
**Don't** put a box with pixel corners inside another one. Inside a card, use a flat fill (`bg-canvas`), and a 2px inset ring (`ring-2 ring-inset`) when it needs an edge.
**Don't** add hard-coded colours, fonts or sizes; add a token instead.
